inverter.comment: Point host/port at the real inverter's Modbus TCP interface (usually port 502) when you have it.

poller.comment: 3s is a safe poll rate per most inverter manuals (2-5s recommended). 1200 samples at 3s = 1 hour of history.

simulator.comment: time_speed 60 = one simulated day passes in 24 real minutes so you can watch the full solar curve. Set to 1 for real time.
